The keyboards come from various brands, including Alienware, Corsair, ROG, Omen, and Cooler Master. Each keyboard box is prominently placed, showcasing different models and designs. The text overlay at the bottom of the image reads: "Switches for mechanical keyboards made in Germany, invented in 19..." with an option to click "more" for additional information.
